## source: docs [R §1] (restore before confirm, rollback of the candidate)
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> restore
Can't find backup of previous configuration!
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> configure
<<< esr-lab-01(config)#
>>> no interface gigabitethernet 1/0/2
<<< esr-lab-01(config)#
>>> do commit
Configuration has been successfully applied and saved to flash. Commit timer started, changes will be reverted in 600 seconds.
<<< esr-lab-01(config)#
>>> do restore
Reversion to the last confirmed configuration is completed.
<<< esr-lab-01(config)#
>>> end
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> show configuration changes
-interface gigabitethernet 1/0/2
-  shutdown
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> rollback
All uncommitted changes have been reverted.
<<< esr-lab-01#
>>> show configuration changes
<<< esr-lab-01#
